A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''fleet officer''' serving under [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] was in charge of the Empire's [[Subjugation of Mon Calamari]]. [[Slavery/Legends|Enslaved]] during the conflict, the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] entered the service of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|fleet]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] as an interpreter and servant. To curry favor from his superior, the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] presented Ackbar to Tarkin, who accepted the Mon Calamari as his personal slave.
